items.q: Nelson Rockefeller was in charge of Latin affairs at that time, and so we went around and we all did this together, Kirby and everybody, and we pulled all sorts of strings to get out of the country, down on this job.

ctx.x: And if you remember, Nelson Rockefeller was in charge of Latin affairs at that time, and so we went around and we all did this together, Kirby and everybody, and we pulled all sorts of strings to get out of the country, down on this job. Because we had it all figured out. We could go down there, and I think it was a year, like we'd all go down there and continue exactly what we were doing and come back rich. Not rich, but well on our way, because you know, we were young at that time and you know, most of the…
